concept_map.chapter_overview: Aaj hum NCERT Class 9 Mathematics ke Chapter 10 — दो चरों वाले रैखिक समीकरण (Linear Equations in Two Variables) — ko padhenge. Pehle ek char wale linear equations ki yaad taza karenge, phir cricket jaisi daily situations se x + y = 176 jaisa two-variable equation banayenge. Standard form ax + by + c = 0, ordered-pair solutions, aur yeh baat clearly samjhenge ki aise equation ke अपरिमित रूप से अनेक हल hote hain — aur har solution graph par ek point hota hai.
concept_map.welcome: Good morning, class! Smart Board par aaj ek bahut useful Maths chapter shuru karte hain — दो चरों वाले रैखिक समीकरण. Socho: do batsmen ne milkar 176 runs banaye, lekin har ek ke runs alag-alag nahi pata. Aise sawalon ko maths mein equation banate hain. Aaj hum seekhenge ki do variables wale linear equation kaise likhte hain, uska solution kya hota hai, aur kyun ek hi nahi — अनगिनत solutions milte hain. Ready ho? Chalo board ki taraf!
learning_outcomes: Ek char wale linear equation se do char wale linear equation tak transition samajhna aur daily situations ko equation mein badalna
ax + by + c = 0 ke standard form mein equation likhna aur a, b, c ke values identify karna (jahan a aur b dono zero nahi)
Solution ko ordered pair (x, y) ke roop mein likhna aur verify karna ki kaunsa pair equation satisfy karta hai
Yeh prove/explain karna ki do char wale linear equation ke अपरिमित रूप से अनेक हल hote hain, aur solution–graph connection yaad rakhna

generated.concept: भूमिका – एक चर वाले रैखिक समीकरणों की याद
generated.say: Bacchon, pehle thodi si revision — previous classes mein tumne एक चर वाले रैखिक समीकरण padhe the. Yaad hai? Jaise x − 1 = 0, x − 2 = 0, aur (2/3)x = 0. Aise equations mein sirf ek unknown hota hai. Aur bahut important baat — ऐसे समीकरणों का एक अद्वितीय हल होता है, matlab ek aur sirf ek solution. Us solution ko number line par bhi dikha sakte ho. Aaj ke chapter mein hum isi knowledge ko aage le jaayenge. Sawal yeh hai: क्या दो चरों वाले रैखिक समीकरण का एक हल होता है? Agar haan, kya woh unique hota hai? Aur Cartesian plane par woh solution kaise dikhega? Yeh questions samajhne ke liye hum Chapter 3 ki coordinate geometry wali concepts bhi use karenge. Edmund Halley ne kaha tha — Analytic Art ka asli kaam mathematical problems ko equations mein laana aur unhe sabse simple form mein dikhana hai. Bilkul wahi hum aaj karenge. Pehle ek familiar example lo: 2x + 5 = 0. Iska solution x = −5/2 hai, aur ise number line par mark kiya jaata hai. Equation solve karte waqt do rules yaad rakho: (i) dono sides mein same number add/subtract karne se equation same rehti hai; (ii) dono sides ko same non-zero number se multiply/divide karne se bhi equation same rehti hai. Yeh foundation strong rakho — aage do variables aayenge!
generated.example: 2x + 5 = 0 ka unique solution x = −5/2 hai; ise number line par −2.5 ke paas mark karte hain.
board_lines: Ek char: x − 1 = 0, x − 2 = 0, (2/3)x = 0 → unique solution
Rules: same number ± / ×÷ (≠0) dono sides → equation unchanged
generated.common_mistake: Students sochte hain ki two-variable equation ka bhi ek hi unique solution hoga jaise one-variable ka — yeh misconception aage clear hogi.
generated.memory_trick: ONE = ONE: Ek variable → Ek unique solution. Do variables aane par rule badlega!
generated.gesture_action: Ek ungli upar karke ‘ek variable’ dikhao, phir number line par imaginary point mark karke unique solution act out karo.

generated.say: Ab ek real situation lete hain — bilkul NCERT jaisi. Nagpur mein India aur Sri Lanka ke beech ODI cricket match hua. Do Indian batsmen ne milkar 176 runs banaye. Is information ko equation mein kaise likhein? Humein individual runs nahi pata — दो अज्ञात राशियाँ hain, two unknowns. Inhe x aur y se denote karte hain. Ek batsman ke runs = x, doosre ke = y. Equation banegi: x + y = 176. Yeh दो चरों वाले रैखिक समीकरण का उदाहरण hai! Tradition mein variables x aur y hote hain, lekin any letters use kar sakte ho. Aur examples: 1.2x + 3y = 5, p + 4q = 7, πu + 5v = 9, aur 3 = 2x − 7y. Inhe zero form mein bhi likho: 1.2x + 3y − 5 = 0, p + 4q − 7 = 0, πu + 5v − 9 = 0, aur 2x − 7y − 3 = 0. Class tip: jab do cheezein mili hon lekin alag-alag na pata ho, socho two variables. Notebook price double of pen — x = notebook, y = pen, toh x = 2y. Yeh Exercise 4.1 ka pehla sawal bhi hai. Cricket se lekar shop tak — linear equation in two variables har jagah milta hai. Agle concept mein ax + by + c = 0 seekhenge.

generated.say: Ab formal definition — NCERT ka heart. Jo equation ax + by + c = 0 ke form mein likhi ja sake, jahan a, b, c वास्तविक संख्याएँ (real numbers) hain, aur a aur b दोनों शून्य नहीं हैं — usse दो चरों वाला रैखिक समीकरण (linear equation in two variables) kehte hain. Matlab a = 0 aur b = 0 ek saath nahi ho sakte. Agar a ≠ 0, b ≠ 0 — classic case. Agar a ≠ 0 lekin b = 0 — phir bhi two-variable form: ax + 0·y + c = 0. Agar a = 0, b ≠ 0 — toh 0·x + by + c = 0. Important: linear isliye kyunki variables ki power 1 hoti hai — x², xy, 1/x jaise terms nahi hone chahiye. Example: 1.2x + 3y = 5 ⇒ 1.2x + 3y − 5 = 0. Yahan a = 1.2, b = 3, c = −5. Similarly p + 4q − 7 = 0. Class tip: c ke sign par dhyan — right se left laate waqt sign reverse hota hai. Definition ke teen hisse yaad rakho: (1) form ax+by+c=0, (2) a,b,c real, (3) a aur b dono zero nahi. Yeh exam mein marks dilate hain!
board_lines: a, b, c ∈ Real numbers; a and b not both zero
generated.common_mistake: Students sochte hain a aur b dono non-zero hone chahiye — actually ‘ दोनों शून्य नहीं’ ka matlab hai dono ek saath zero nahi; ek zero ho sakta hai.
generated.memory_trick: A-B-C ZERO: Form ax+by+c=0; A aur B dono zero nahi. C kuch bhi ho sakta hai!
generated.gesture_action: Board par ax + by + c = 0 likho; a aur b ke neeche underline karke ‘not both zero’ circle karo.
real_life_examples: Mobile recharge: 2 packs + 3 packs = fixed amount → 2x + 3y − amount = 0
Farming: fertilizer bags x aur y milakar fixed cost — same form

generated.concept: समीकरण को मानक रूप में लिखना
generated.say: Ab Example 1 — equations ko ax + by + c = 0 mein badalna aur a, b, c batana. (i) 2x + 3y = 4.37 → 2x + 3y − 4.37 = 0; a = 2, b = 3, c = −4.37. (ii) x − 4 = (1/3)y → x − (1/3)y − 4 = 0; a = 1, b = −1/3, c = −4. (iii) 4 = 5x − 3y ⇒ 5x − 3y − 4 = 0; a = 5, b = −3, c = −4. Interesting: ise −5x + 3y + 4 = 0 bhi likh sakte ho — dono sides −1 se multiply; tab a = −5, b = 3, c = 4. Dono sahi! (iv) 2x = y ⇒ 2x − y + 0 = 0; a = 2, b = −1, c = 0. Yaad rakho: c = 0 allowed hai. Board tip: sab terms left, right = 0; signs carefully reverse karo. Exercise 4.1 isi pattern ka hai — 2x + 3y = 9.35, −2x + 3y = 6, x = 3y, 2x = −5y, 3x + 2 = 0, y − 2 = 0, 5 = 2x. Har ek mein a, b, c identify karo. Common error: 2x = −5y se 2x + 5y = 0 banate waqt sign galat kar dena. Practice se strong ho jayega.
generated.common_mistake: Students c ka sign galat rakhte hain — right side se left laate waqt number ka sign reverse karna zaroori hai.
generated.memory_trick: LEFT-ZERO: Sab left lao, right zero karo; jo peeche aaya uska sign उल्टा!

generated.say: Example 2 bahut smart hai — lagta hai ek variable wala equation hai, lekin hum use two-variable form mein likh sakte hain! (i) x = −5 ko 1·x + 0·y = −5, ya 1·x + 0·y + 5 = 0 likho. Yahan a = 1, b = 0, c = 5. (ii) y = 2 ⇒ 0·x + 1·y − 2 = 0; a = 0, b = 1, c = −2. (iii) 2x = 3 ⇒ 2x + 0·y − 3 = 0. (iv) 5y = 2 ⇒ 0·x + 5y − 2 = 0. NCERT clearly kehta hai: ax + c = 0 bhi two-variable linear equation ka example hai, kyunki ise ax + 0·y + c = 0 likha ja sakta hai. Jaise 4 − 3x = 0 ⇒ −3x + 0·y + 4 = 0. Kyun important? Graph par x = −5 vertical line hoti hai, y = 2 horizontal line. Solution ke liye — x = −5 mein x hamesha −5, y kuch bhi — isliye infinite solutions! Exercise mein 3x + 2 = 0, y − 2 = 0, 5 = 2x isi family ke hain. Common doubt: b = 0 hai toh two variable kaise? Answer: missing variable ka coefficient zero hai; definition tab tak valid hai jab a aur b दोनों साथ में zero na hon.

generated.concept: हल का अर्थ – क्रमित युग्म (x, y)
generated.say: Section 4.3 — रैखिक समीकरण का हल. Ek variable mein solution ek number hota hai. Do variables mein solution ka matlab hai x aur y ke मानों का युग्म jo equation को संतुष्ट kare. Equation lo: 2x + 3y = 12. Check: x = 3, y = 2. Substitute: 2(3) + 3(2) = 6 + 6 = 12. Yes! Ise क्रमित युग्म (ordered pair) (3, 2) likhte hain — pehle x, baad mein y. Order matter karta hai! (0, 4) bhi solution hai: 2(0)+3(4)=12. Lekin (1, 4) nahi: 2(1)+3(4)=14 ≠ 12. Aur dhyan do — (0, 4) solution hai, lekin (4, 0) nahi: 2(4)+3(0)=8 ≠ 12. Isliye order aur values dono check karo. Easy NCERT tip: x = 0 lo, y nikaalo; ya y = 0 lo, x nikaalo — intercept solutions jaldi mil jaate hain. Example 3: x + 2y = 6 ke solutions (2,2) kyunki 2+4=6; phir (0,3), (6,0), aur y=1 se (4,1). Example 4: 4x+3y=12 ⇒ (0,4) aur (3,0); 2x+5y=0 ⇒ (0,0) aur (1,−2/5); 3y+4=0 ⇒ y=−4/3 for any x, jaise (0,−4/3) aur (1,−4/3). Class mein verification habit banao — har claimed solution ko substitute karke zaroor check karo!
board_lines: Solution = ordered pair (x, y) that satisfies the equation
Tip: put x=0 (find y) or y=0 (find x) for quick solutions
generated.common_mistake: (0, 4) और (4, 0) को same समझना — ordered pair में क्रम मायने रखता है; एक हल हो तो दूसरा ज़रूरी नहीं।
